name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Boris, Vera, and Pirc go with Discovery, Sacrifice, and Zwischenzug, in some order.
Either Judit goes with Sacrifice or someone in the Morning Study Group goes with Boris.
Vera does not go with Slav if and only if Sacrifice does not go with Boris.
French goes with none of Anatoly, Judit, or Vera.
Between Vera and Pirc, one goes with Sacrifice and the other with Zwischenzug.
